BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION MO/2023)
CLASS: BAM   SEMESTER : III
BRANCH: A&M  SESSION : MO/2023

SUBJECT: AM202 VISUAL COMMUNICATION
TIME: 02 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q.1(a) Draw and label the X-Y process/ paradigm of communication in details. [2]
Q.1(b) Describe this process of communication in details. [3]


Q.2(a) What are the four basic skills of communication? [2]
Q.2(b) Who is the ‘receiver’? What role does the receiver play in the process of communication? [3]


Q.3(a) What do you understand by the term ‘Society’. [1]
Q.3(b) What is ‘Culture’? Do you believe that communication plays A vital in Our culture? [4]


Q.4(a) Draw a well labelled diagram of the Human Eye. [2]
Q.4(b) What is the relationship between colour & culture?
OR
Is it important to understand the elements of art in Visual Communication?
[3]


Q.5(a) What do you understand by ‘memory? [2]
Q.5(b) Draw a colourful picture to powerfully communicate ‘beauty’. [3]
